title: Binance incident reserve reconciliation, native XRP freeze semantics and market-event controls

decisions.decision: Keep Binance's $6.34B aggregate allocation and market/OTC replacement plan separate from XRP-specific demand. Require token-level reserve or execution evidence.
decisions.validation: Await post-incident PoR snapshot and any disclosed XRP-specific transactions.

decisions.decision: Treat TRM's 233.46M XRP transfer as sourced on-chain analysis, but the receiver balance as stale after 2026-10-30 00:30 UTC.
decisions.validation: Obtain a fresh raw XRPL account_info and complete transaction-history snapshot with validated ledger index and cutoff.

decisions.decision: Separate native XRP from issued RLUSD, USDC, USDT and USD1. Issuers may freeze their own issued tokens, not native XRP.
decisions.validation: Use XRPL protocol documentation; never count the 40.5M RLUSD freeze as XRP recovered.

decisions.decision: Preserve Alpha and Liqwall open interest as provider-specific observations. Do not average the 2.13x discrepancy.
decisions.validation: Reconcile contract IDs, venue coverage, quote currency, notional conversion and timestamps before feature admission.

decisions.decision: Treat Oct30 ETF -$0.7M as partial T+1, two of five funds only.
decisions.validation: Re-read all five fund reports after completion; reconcile issuer creations/redemptions.

decisions.decision: Use the Binance event as an event-study candidate, not a directional signal. Control for BTC/ETH, market-wide risk, funding, liquidations, spot depth, ETF flows and incident timestamps.
decisions.validation: No causal event study or calibrated probability produced in this run.

decisions.decision: Keep TRM's TraderTraitor attribution as a high-confidence provider assessment, not an official law-enforcement conclusion.
decisions.validation: Require independent or official corroboration before reclassification.

decisions.decision: Keep all new market observations out of the prediction feature store until provider coverage and point-in-time controls pass.
decisions.validation: market_features_admitted remains false; forecast remains NOT_ISSUED.

next_actions: Refresh the attacker receiver using raw XRPL public-node account_info and transaction history.
Crosswalk the five Binance XRPL source wallets against the official post-incident PoR address export.
Reconcile Binance's token-level reserve replacement by XRP, BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, RLUSD and other affected assets.
Re-read all five XRP ETF funds after Oct30 T+1 completion.
Resolve Alpha/Liqwall OI universe mismatch and preserve venue-level funding/liquidations.
Build a controlled event study with broad-market controls; no forecast until fixed-horizon calibration and walk-forward gates pass.
